name: DnaJ heat shock protein family (Hsp40) member B1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: DNAJB1 encodes dnaJ homolog subfamily B member 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription regulator inhibitor activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and forebrain development.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Fibrolamellar carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: DNAJB1 encodes dnaJ homolog subfamily B member 1. It interacts with HSP70 and can stimulate its ATPase activity. It acts also with TTC1 as a chaperone adapter that regulates HSP70-dependent folding process by interacting with the HSP70 amino terminal region. It stimulates the association between HSC70 and HIP.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving DNAJB1 have been reported in fibrolamellar carcinoma.
